answer: An admission auction guards the garden like a cedar fence: the network sells only 100 work slots per epoch, and each agent bids POA for one. An attacker needing 200 fakes must win 200 auctions at about 40 POA each, paying 8,000 POA, while honest agents pay once and keep the full reward. Losing bids are refunded, so honest bidders risk little. No fable of free entry survives the math: mass fakery costs more than the pool it tries to steal.
